services.title: Business Setup Services
services.intro: Choose the help you need before, during, or after forming a U.S. company.
sections: Form an LLC
Prepare your business information, review the state filing instructions, and compare what providers actually include. [Explore LLC Formation](services/llc-formation/)
Find a registered agent
Compare the annual renewal cost, document handling, and state coverage before choosing a provider. [Explore Registered Agent Services](services/registered-agent/)
Apply for an EIN
Review the information to gather and the official IRS application routes. [Explore EIN Assistance](services/ein-assistance/)
How to compare a quote
Ask for the state filing fee, provider charge, and optional items on separate lines.
Confirm which services renew and whether renewal is automatic.
Ask what happens if the filing needs a correction or the provider cannot accept your application.

services/llc-formation.title: LLC Formation
services/llc-formation.intro: Prepare your information, understand the filing process, and see what to check before ordering a formation package.
sections: Before you file
Identify the state where you plan to operate and check whether registration there or in another state may be necessary.
Check the state naming rules and verify availability with the filing office.
Confirm your registered agent and the addresses the filing form requires.
Ask for an itemized quote
Separate state filing fees from the service charge. Ask which documents the provider prepares, whether the registered agent is included, and how long any introductory pricing lasts.
After filing

Keep the filed formation document and confirmation. Review your operating agreement, EIN needs, licensing, and annual obligations. Start with the [SBA guide to registering your business](https://www.sba.gov/business-guide/launch-your-business/register-your-business).
Related services
Review [Registered Agent Services](services/registered-agent/) and [EIN Assistance](services/ein-assistance/).

services/registered-agent.title: Registered Agent Services
services/registered-agent.intro: Understand what a registered agent handles and what to ask a provider before choosing one.
sections: What the agent does

A registered agent receives official papers for the business and must be located in the state of registration. Confirm which documents the provider scans, forwards, or stores. See the [SBA registration guide](https://www.sba.gov/business-guide/launch-your-business/register-your-business).
What to compare
Ask for the first-year price and the rate when the service renews.
Ask how quickly notices appear and whether forwarding costs extra.
Confirm whether the price includes only agent service or a separate business mailing service.
Ask how to cancel or change agents and which filing is required.
If you are switching
Review your state's instructions, coordinate the effective date with the new agent, and keep the state's confirmation. [Browse State Guides](states/)

services/ein-assistance.title: EIN Assistance
services/ein-assistance.intro: Gather the details for your federal Employer Identification Number application and review your options.
sections: Before applying
Confirm the legal name and formation details on your documents. Determine who the responsible party is and check which details the IRS requires for your application.
Apply through the IRS

The IRS issues EINs directly at no charge. The application method can depend on where your principal business is located and the responsible party’s information. Check the [official IRS EIN instructions](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/employer-identification-number) before choosing a method.
If you use a paid service

Ask which support the fee buys, who will prepare and submit the application, and how you will receive the confirmation. Read the [IRS Form SS-4 instructions](https://www.irs.gov/instructions/iss4) before authorizing anyone to act on your behalf.

states.title: U.S. State Guides
states.intro: Compare the questions to answer before choosing a state and open the official filing information.
sections: Featured state guides
[Wyoming LLC guide](states/wyoming/)
[Delaware LLC guide](states/delaware/)
[Texas LLC guide](states/texas/)
Other states
Use the [50-state selector](#setup) on the homepage to build a checklist. Use your state filing office for the current forms and fee schedule.
Decide based on how you operate
Consider where you have an office, employees, or regular business activity.
Compare the cost to form, annual filings or taxes, and renewal charges for a registered agent.

Ask whether you may also need to register in another state where you operate. The [SBA registration guide](https://www.sba.gov/business-guide/launch-your-business/register-your-business) covers this question.

states/wyoming.title: Wyoming LLC Setup
states/wyoming.intro: Find the Wyoming filing starting point and see what to review before and after forming.
sections: Prepare the filing

Use the Wyoming Secretary of State’s [business forms page](https://sos.wyo.gov/Business/Forms.aspx) to find the LLC Articles of Organization and related instructions. Review registered agent and address requirements before filing.
Budget for the next year
Look up the state's annual report requirements and current fees. If you hire a registered agent, ask for their renewal cost separately from the state's charges.
Before choosing Wyoming

If you will operate elsewhere, use the [SBA registration guide](https://www.sba.gov/business-guide/launch-your-business/register-your-business) to check whether another registration may be needed. [Compare other states](states/)

states/delaware.title: Delaware LLC Setup
states/delaware.intro: Start with Delaware’s official formation instructions and review costs beyond the initial filing.
sections: Prepare the filing

Delaware's [formation guide](https://corp.delaware.gov/howtoform/) walks through choosing an entity and a Delaware registered agent. Review the Certificate of Formation and the filing options it links to.
Review ongoing obligations
Check Delaware’s current LLC tax guidance before paying a provider. Ask for the first-year and renewal costs so the initial filing price does not obscure ongoing expenses.
Compare with your operating state
Check whether activities in another state could trigger a second registration. [Compare other states](states/)

states/texas.title: Texas LLC Setup
states/texas.intro: Review the Texas filing forms, registered agent details, and follow-up requirements before ordering a service.
sections: Prepare the filing

Find the Texas LLC Certificate of Formation on the [Secretary of State forms page](https://www.sos.state.tx.us/corp/forms_boc.shtml). Review the instructions for the registered agent, registered office, and business information.
Check post-formation requirements
Review [Texas Comptroller franchise tax guidance](https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/franchise/) and relevant local permits for your activities. Put applicable filing deadlines on your calendar.
Ask for a complete quote
Compare the state filing fee, preparation cost, and registered agent renewal before selecting a package. [Browse provider profiles](providers/)

providers.title: U.S. Formation Providers
providers.intro: A starting list for researching providers. Check eligibility, package details, and current prices directly before ordering.
sections: Northwest Registered Agent
Explore its [LLC formation services](https://www.northwestregisteredagent.com/llc). Ask which address and agent services are included and when they renew.
Inc Authority
Explore [formation services](https://www.incauthority.com/). Confirm state fees, optional add-ons, and the registered agent renewal price.
CorpNet
Explore [formation and compliance services](https://www.corpnet.com/). Ask which filings can be bundled and what ongoing support costs.
LLC Attorney
Explore [formation and registered agent services](https://llcattorney.com/). Confirm which package features, address services, and support are included.
doola
Explore [services for U.S. and international founders](https://www.doola.com/). Ask about country eligibility, plan inclusions, annual costs, and cancellation terms.
How to compare
Record the initial service price, state fees, renewal rate, state coverage, and eligibility in the same order for each provider. Use the official links above for the latest details.

how-it-works.title: How Renz Works
how-it-works.intro: Go from a general idea to a checklist you can use when researching or choosing a service.
sections: 1. Choose a state
Select a formation state or leave it undecided. The [State Guides](states/) explain where to start.
2. Pick the task
Choose LLC formation, registered agent services, EIN assistance, or help deciding.
3. Review your checklist
The homepage form builds a brief checklist in your browser. Use it to gather information and prepare questions for a provider.
4. Confirm details with the provider
Before paying, confirm eligibility, total initial price, renewal terms, and what the company will deliver. See [provider profiles](providers/).

resources.title: Business Setup Resources
resources.intro: Checklists and official starting points for U.S. founders preparing to file or compare services.
sections: Business setup checklist
Before filing: choose a state, check the proposed business name, and confirm agent arrangements.
After filing: keep the accepted document, check EIN and licensing needs, and record annual deadlines.
Before paying a provider: confirm what’s included, how long a quote applies, and what renews.
For founders outside the U.S.

Ask each provider whether it accepts applicants in your country of residence and what verification it requires. Check the [IRS EIN page](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/employer-identification-number) for application options. Verify bank or payment-provider eligibility separately.
Official starting points
[SBA: Register your business](https://www.sba.gov/business-guide/launch-your-business/register-your-business)
[IRS: Employer Identification Numbers](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/employer-identification-number)
[State filing guides](states/)

about.title: About Renz
about.intro: Renz helps founders organize their next steps for setting up a business in the United States.
sections: What you can explore
The site covers LLC formation, registered agents, and EIN applications. The [service pages](services/) describe what to prepare and which questions to ask.
How to use this information
Use the checklists as starting points. Check official forms and provider terms before filing or paying. For legal or tax advice about your specific business, speak with a qualified professional.

contact.title: Contact Renz
contact.intro: Plan what to include when you ask for help with a setup question.
sections: Prepare your question
Have your intended formation state, service, and current stage ready. If you are comparing providers, include the name of the package and the price you were quoted.
Request status
Direct messaging is not available in this version. You can [build a setup checklist](#setup) now.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: How the current Renz site uses selections made in the setup tool.
sections: Setup tool
Your state and service selections generate a checklist in your current browser. The setup tool does not store those selections or send them to Renz.
External websites
Official agencies and providers linked from Renz operate under their own privacy terms. Review the destination before entering personal, payment, or company information.
